profile.headline: Software Engineer at Cerner Corporation
profile.summary:
I have been interested in all aspects of programming and circuitry all of my life. As a hobby, I design build and test circuits that interface with the real world. Using PCs, Raspberry Pis, Picaxe chips and basic components, I have made many projects from a simple LED lit Christmas tree that used buttons to change the light colors and patterns to life size animatronics that move and talk. To get my creations to do what I ask them to, I use multiple different computer languages depending on the system I build. I have used the following languages in my projects: Visual basic 6.0, Visual basic .net,  Python, PHP, HTML, Java Script and a few different basic languages.

What I am looking for in a career is the ability to work on interesting projects that challenge me and that I find the completion of rewarding.

positions.title: Owner/Operator
positions.description:
Handle every aspect of running a state licensed small business
Used Visual Basic .net to create a reporting system for tracking each child's day and emailing the report to parents. This increased communication, parental awareness of the child's day and gave metrics on each child that were used to enhance each child's daycare experience.

positions.title: Network Analyst II
positions.description: Used Visual Basic to create an interface between the users and Sprint's long distance switches. Wrote scripts to automate processes and generate timely, detailed reports for department heads which reduced response times and revenue loss.

positions.title: Quality Inspector
positions.description:
Ensured product quality by using laser micrometers to measure part dimensions.
Created reports of test results for management using Office 97.
General help desk for the 10 computers on the production floor LAN.
Trained users on using the computer systems and any new software implemented in the lab.
Accomplishments: Redesigned many printed reports and reporting techniques, which allowed more efficient entry and retrieval of data.

positions.title: Machine Operator
positions.description:
Efficiently produced quality product by checking product quality, maintaining machines and logging abnormalities.
Quickly resolved machine and product quality problems with as little disruption to production as possible.
Helped teammates do the same.
Recorded product start and stop times, logged machine statistics and entered product information into a database.
